L1DY: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.
Cast away your doubt, meet the Guru and you shall know the condition of the inner-self.
T6B0: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.
While alive annihilate yours evil inclinations for that House where you have to reach after death.
9UJC: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||
The fascinating celestial strain is obtained through the discerning wisdom imparted by the Guru.
347C: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.
Through Gurbani, that unbeaten melody is procured and there with egotism is annulled.
RQLD: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.
I am ever a sacrifice to him who serves his True Guru.
T4AY: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||
He within whose mouth God's Name abides, is taken to God's Court and is dressed (with the robe of honour).
H7P7: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.
In the universe the union of sensitiveness and stupefaction wherever I see, I find God pervading there.
KLTW: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.
The body is bound down by three dispositions. Who-so-ever comes in this world he plays (subject to their hint).
D9RH: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||
The separatists part way with the Lord and are in anguish. Those self-willed obtain not union (with Him).
K68W: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,
Becoming desire-free, if the mind abides in home and is dyed red in the fear of the True Lord,
6TJ5: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.
it shall then enjoy the Supreme Nectar of Divine Knowledge and shall not feel hunger again.
JXKW: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||
Nanak, subdue this mind and meet the Lord, thus you shall suffer agony no more.
3R10: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.
This foolish and greedy mind is attached with and lured by greed.
FGSV: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.
Being materialist and of evil intellect, it drenches not in God's Name and continues coming and going.
65LS: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
If man meets the Saintly True Guru, then, does he find (God) the treasure of excellences.
DTPT: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.
O (my) mind! renounce self-worship and self-conceit.
J5QZ: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Serve you God-model Guru an ocean of piety, so that you mayest obtain honour in His Court. Pause.
DKKP: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.
Meditate on God God's Name day and night and by Guru's grace deem God's Name your treasure.
J5HC: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.
By meeting the society of saints you shall acquire Divine Knowledge and enjoy all comforts and God's elixir.
SDSD: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||
He, whom the True Guru has given the Name, ever serves Lord God day and night.
JGKB: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.
He, who practices falsehood is like a dog and burns in the fire of slandering the Guru.
332L: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.
He goes astray in doubt and suffers great agony. Death's myrmidon beats him to pulp.
C02H: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||
An apostate procures not peace. One resigned to Guru's will is wonderfully joyous.
EPMK: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.
Here man is engrossed in false pursuits (but there) the writ of true actions is acceptable.
JPJP: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.
The Guru serves God, his intimate, and Guru's actions are the most exalted.
DHBV: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||
Nanak, he forgets not God's Name and he bears the mark of the True Lord's grace.
GE98: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.
To forget the Beloved, even for an instant, produces great affliction in the soul.
G2KR: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?
How can honour be acquired in god's Court, if He dwells not in mortal's mind?
476A: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||
By meeting the Guru, peace is obtained and the fire of desire is quenched in (by singing) Lord's praises.
NPLQ: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
O my Soul! day and night deliberate over the excellences of God.
EJ1E: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||
What forget not God's Name even for a moment and an instant ; such persons are rare in this world. Pause.
B5D6: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,
When human light blends with the Supreme Light and the union of wisdom is effaced with the universal wisdom,
55QS: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.
then mortal's killing-instinct and egotism depart and scepticism and sorrow afflict him not.
2MG6: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||
The Guru-ward, within whose mind abides the Lord, him the Guru unites with Lord's union.
V4UP: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.
If I surrender my body like a bride to the Master, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.
QWAE: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.
Make not love with him, who appears to be but a passing-show.
AYQS: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||
That Lord Consort, on His couch, enjoys the virtuous and chaste brides.2

2Z9E: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.
By obtaining the water of God's Name, through the Guru, quench the four fires (of cruelty, wordly-love, anger and greed) and remain dead in life.
BEMC: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.
Thus the heart-lotus blossom be filled with Nectar and you shall be satiated.
GNHS: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||
Nanak make the True Guru your friend, then going to His Court you shall obtain the True One.
VRTP: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.
Obtain Guru's instruction, O my dear! repeat God's Name and contemplate over Lord God.
LZDH: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.
Apply the touch-stone of Truthfulness to your soul, and see if it weighs its full weight.
AY6D: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
No one has found its worth. Invaluable is the value of the soul emerald.
JT2F: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.
O Brother! God, the jewel, resides in the Guru.
9LFZ: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
In the society of saints, the True Guru is obtained. Day and night praise God's Name, (O ; Man!). Pause.
WFN3: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.
By obtaining light from the Guru, acquire the true wealth and real merchandise.
M8AD: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.
As fire is extinguished by pouring water, similarly the desire becomes the slave of (is quenched by) God's slaves.
PG8U: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||
The courier of death shall touch you not and like this you shall cross and causes others to cross the terrible life ocean.
1BU2: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.
The Guru's slaves like not untruth. With sincere love they are dyed in nothing but Truth.
ZFC0: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.
The mammon-worshipper likes not Truthfulness. False is the foundation of the false.
4QHW: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||
Being tainted with Truth, one meets the Guru, The true persons are absorbed in the True Lord.
5WQG: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.
In the mind are emerald, rubies pearls, valuables and jewels of God's Name.
214A: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.
The True merchandise and wealth is the Name of the infinitely deep Lord, who permeates all the hearts.
33JK: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||
Nanak were God, the Gem, to show favour, He is obtained through the Exalted Guru.
7AQH: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.
The fire of doubt extinguishes not, even though man may wander in foreign lands and countries.
JBF5: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.
Accursed is the life and doomed the religious garb of him, whose heart's filth is not removed.
5YYH: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
Except through the True Guru's instruction, there is no other way to perform Lord's devotional service.
YJJV: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.
O my soul! extinguish the fire through the Guru.
D8ZW: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||
Abide by Guru's word within your mind and still your ego and desire. Pause.
YQT5: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.
The mind jewel is priceless, but it is through Lord's Name that it attains honour.
6YSE: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.
By Guru's grace, embrace love for God and by associating with the true congregation, obtain the Lord.
L04A: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||
By erasing self-conceit man attains peace and like water merging with water, blends (with the Lord).
R5JW: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.
Those who have not contemplated over the Name of Lord God they are without merits and continue coming and going.
2DZD: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.
He who has not met the Divine True Guru bothers and suffers in the terrible life-ocean.
CS5G: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||
This soul jewel is priceless, in this way it is being lost in exchange for a shell.
917S: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.
Whom the True Guru joyfully meets, they are the perfectly wise persons.
UJFZ: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.
By meeting the Guru, the terrible world-ocean is crossed and man's honour becomes acceptable in God's Court.
UV9S: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||
O Nanak! bright are the faces of those within whose mind the music of Gurbani is apparently struck.
96W6: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.
O traders! strike the bargain, and take care of (the True) merchandise.
X7PW: Buy that object which will go along with you.
Purchase such goods as may last with You.
ZJWW: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||
In the next world the wise Merchant will take and preserve the genuine article.
FLB0: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.
O Brother! repeat God's Name by fixing your attention.
8L9E: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||
Take and depart with the merchandise of God's praises. The Spouse shall view and be satisfied with it. Pause.3

YVF5: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?
Who have not the capital of righteousness, how shall they find peace?
AFKH: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.
By dealing in false trade, soul and body become false.
CKSC: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||
Like the deer ensnared is a snare, they come to great grief and ever bewail.
1G10: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.
The counterfeit are not consigned to the divine treasury. They obtain not the sight of the great God.
SEQX: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.
The false one has no caste and honour. No one succeeds through falsehood.
VM75: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||
The untrue mortal practises untruth and loses his honour in transmigration.
KSMS: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.
O Nanak! By Guru's Instruction and counsel instruct your mind.
GCRN: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.
Those, who are imbued with the love of the Name of Pervading Lord, have no load of sin and no scepticism
3R5B: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||
Those, in whose heart God abides, are dauntless and by meditating on God, they earn a great gain.
7JXR: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
CLJC: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.
Wealth, youth, and flowers are guests only for four days.
WTTY: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||
Like the leaves or water lily, they whither, fade (and finally) die away.
XBDK: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.
Enjoy Lord's love, O dear one! so long as you have buoyant fresh youth.
AKET: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||
Few are yours days, you have grown weary and the body vesture has grown old. Pause.
DLVJ: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.
My playful friend has gone to sleep in the graveyard.
T48U: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||
I, double minded, too shall depart and weep with a feeble voice.
VN1F: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?
Within yours ears, O my fair coloured soul! why you hearest not this fact?
81ZJ: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||
You shall go to your in laws and cannot stay with your parents for ever.
LEBS: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.
O Nanak, know that she, who is asleep in her parent's home, is burgled in broad day light.
ZPJL: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||
She is departing after having lost her bundle of merits and has tied one of demerits.
W1CX: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
W0SS: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.
Lord Himself is the Relisher, Himself the Relish, and Himself the Enjoyer.
U56G: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||
He Himself is the Vesture (bride) and Himself the Couch and Bridegroom.
LXAB: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||
My Master is dyed with love and is fully pervading every where. Pause.
MBVW: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.
He Himself is the fisherman and the fish and Himself the water and the net.
RLLJ: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||
He Himself is the metal ball of the net and Himself the bait within.
EJJ3: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.
My maid! my Beloved is in every way playful.
6BAX: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||
He ever enjoys the virtuous wife. Behold my plight (away from Him.)
NQ64: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.
Prays Nanak, listen to my supplication. You are the tank and You the swan.
SXPF: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||
You are the lotus and You the water-lily. You Yourself are pleased on beholding (them).
PBSQ: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
AYSX: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.
Make this body the field, good actions the seed, and irrigate it with the water of the Name of God, the holder of earth in his hands.
0Q6G: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||
Make your soul the cultivator, God will germinate in your heat and you shall, thus, obtain the dignity of emancipation.
FM0W: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?
O Fool! why takest you pride on wealth?
LAFX: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||
Father, sons, wife, mother and all other (relations) become not your helpers in the end.
YGPG: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.
Weed out evil wickedness and sins. Leaving these and becoming single-minded, meditate (on the Lord).
L97U: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||
When Lord's meditation, arduous service and control of evil passions become guides, then does the heart lotus bloom and honey trickles.
4PWD: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.
Amass (control) your body residing place of twenty seven elements, and ever remember death in the three caves (stage) of life.
7MM8: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||
Behold the limitless Lord in ten directions and eighteen (loads of vegetation). Says Nanak, like this the One Master shall save you.4

07U9: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
SGZF: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.
Make pious deeds your farm, Guru's Word do you make your seed and ever irrigate with the water of truth.
CTTA: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
Become a husbandman and your faith shall germinate. O fool! know thus, your paradise and hell.
V8G6: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.
Deem not that the Spouse is obtained by mere words.
APFB: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||
In the pride of wealth and the splendour of beauty, in this way you have lost your life. Pause.
4D0D: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.
The sin of the body is the puddle and this soul the frog, which values not at all the lotus-flower.
H434: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||
Guru, the bumble -bee ever repeats the Divine sermons but how can man understand them, when (God) does not make him understand?
6EK5: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.
The preaching and listening of religious discourse is like the sough of wind for those, whose soul is tinctured with mammon.
Y6PF: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||
Centering their attention on the Husband alone, those who meditate on Him; His grace descends on them and they become pleasing to His heart.
GAW0: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.
Even though you keepest thirty (fasts) and takest with the five comrades (i.e. the five prayers) but beware, lest the one, who goes by the name of Satan should undo their merit.
ZSTQ: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||
Says, Nanak, you have to go the way (of death). What for have you amassed property and wealth?
2VHH: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
1WWA: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.
He is the Master who has make the world blossom and reverdured the universe.
7L15: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
Hall! to the Creator who has kept in bondage the water and land.
UFD7: Death, O Maulvi! death must come.
ZLDS: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||
All the same abide in the fear of the Maker. Pause.
WTKU: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.
Then alone you are a Mullah or then alone are a Qazi, if you knowest the name of God.
5GE7: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||
Even though man be very learned none can stay here when his measured of life becomes full.
9C6X: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.
He is the Qazi who has renounced self-conceit and made the name of God alone his support.
93T1: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||
That True Creator, is and shall also, be, was not born and shall not perish.
MHXK: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.
You recitest prayer five times a day and readest holy books ant the Quran.
M1WN: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||
Says Nanak, the grave calls you and now yours food and drink have come to an end.
BHM8: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
3818: The dogs of greed are with me.
I have a dog and two bitches with me.
P9H4: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
Early in the morn, they ever bark at the wind.
8YDA: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
Falsehood is my dagger and to eat by defrauding is carrion.
MZL8: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||
I live in the form of a hunts man, O Creator!
ZSFU: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
I follow not the counsel of my Spouse nor do I good deeds.
HGP5: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
C2DT: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.
Your Name alone saves the world.
EV3Y: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
This alone is my hope and this the mainstay. Pause.
EDLH: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
With my mouth, I utter calumny day and night.
GH4M: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
I am base and a wretch and spy other's house.
3RQQ: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
Lust and wrath, the pariahs, abide in my body.
4GE8: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
I live in the form of huntsman, O Creator!
JCTH: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
I am gentle in appearance, but my intent is to entrap others.
6EJQ: I am a robber-I rob the world.
I am a cheat and cheat the country (world).
D6XS: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
I am very clever and carry the great load of sin.
4N0E: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
I live in the form of huntsman, O Creator!
5HU4: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.
I, a partaker of other's wealth, have not appreciated what You have done for me.
HYV8: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
What face shall, I a villainous thief show You, O Lord?
GUZ5: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
Nanak the lowly says this thought.
JHLB: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||
I live in the form of huntsman, O Creator!
X87P: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
Q68D: There is one awareness among all created beings.
There is the same inner conscious-ness among all the beings.
4C98: None have been created without this awareness.
Without inner consciousness He has created none.5

RAW6: As is their awareness, so is their way.
As is the consciousness, so is their way.
YQLE: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
He alone (call mortals) to account (and subject) to his order they come and go.
ESBH: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?
O mortals! why do you practise cleverness?
8TS7: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||
In taking back and giving God makes no delay. Pause.
NP5N: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,
The beings are Yours and You are their (Master).
2HNV: how can You become angry with them?
What for are You then enraged with them, O Lord?
V2KG: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,
If You in rage be O Lord!
YP6L: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||
Still You are theirs and they are Yours.
7PFK: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.
We the foul-tongued spoil every thing by (our thoughtless) words.
5S6M: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.
Within Your sight, You weighest their weight (worth).
VF3M: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.
Where the deeds are virtuous, there is the perfect understanding.
2YXZ: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||
Sans meritorious actions, it is awfully deficient.
1VVP: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?
Supplicates Nanak, of what king is the man of Divine knowledge?
EZKJ: They are self-realized; they understand God.
He who recognises his ownself comprehends Him.

my soul and body are all at Your disposal.

28KL: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

He, who owns forest-trees, the garden and the plants,

gives then such names as is their inherent nature.

KQBY: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.

Insipid is the relish of intellect without salt (sans God's Name).
UADG: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.

0CU0: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:

As the Lord keeps it, so does it live. (under its influence,) the mind of this greedy man is tossed about.

Let the practise of reciting the religious booms

and service is performed happiness is obtained.6

All the world continues coming and going.

In this world perform Lord's service.

Then, (shall you) get a seat in Masters Court,

and swing your arm (happily) says Nanak.

There is but one God, by the True Guru's grace He is obtained.

I lovingly service my True Guru with single mind and rapt attention.

He, whom God instructs, beholds in the True Guru the heart's desire, the place of pilgrimage.
H8FG: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.
He attains the mind desired blessing and obtains the boon that he wills.

Meditate on God's Name worship the name and through the Name enter the realm of supreme bliss.

They, who have served the True Guru, have obtained the Name treasure.

Their mind lotus blooms and their attention remains fixed (in the Lord in the State of Equipoise).

905P: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

They who possess the inexhaustible Name, of the Infinite Lord's remain happy in the four ages.

By meeting the Guru, God's Name is obtained and the thirst of worldly love departs.

I am a sacrifice to those, who enjoy the taste of God's Name.

Even then, without the True Guru, you shall not obtain happiness and receive births over and over again.

True is the reputation of the true person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells.

O My Omnipresent Lord! I have no other except God.

The True Immaculate Lord is met by the instruction of the True Guru. Pause.

He, Whom God Himself unites, meets Him and remains blended with Him.

Through profane love none meets God and he, over and over again continues coming and going.

The One (Lord) is dwelling among all. (He is Unique) One is pervading every where.

They act in accordance with the pre-ordained writ which none is potent to erase.

The service of the True Guru is hard. It is obtained by surrendering one's head and by eliminating self-conceit.

If man realises the Word, then does he meet God and all his service becomes acceptable.

By coming in contact with the invaluable (personality) of the Guru, the mortal becomes invaluable himself and his light is absorbed in the Supreme Light.
F5R3: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||
The True Guru comes and meets those who are so pre-ordained.

O My soul! cry not that you are hungry and without provisions and do you make no complaint regarding it.

He, who has created eight-four lakhs of species, gives sustenance to all.

The Fearless Lord is ever Merciful, He takes care of all.

Stainless are they who are imbued with God's Name. I am ever a sacrifice to them.

They, who by Guru's teaching, recognise God, ever behold Him just present.

By being imbued, night and day in Lord's meditation, their mind and body become pure.
0C6W: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.
False is the colour (of mammon) like safflower's. Man weeps in pain when it vanishes.8

QT07: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

O Nanak! ever True is the Word of those, who remain attached with the love of Lord's Name.

They who with single-mind, contemplate over God's Name and dwell upon Guru's teaching,

They are the worms of ordure fall in ordure and get absorbed in ordure.
UJVP: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
Fruitful is life of those, who walk (live) according to True Guru's will.
BQRU: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.
They save their family and blessed is their mother who bore them.

He, whom the Master of will shows favour, repeats the Name of Lord God.

They praise God's Name for ever and ever, Lord's Name is their merchandise and support.

The perfect Guru has implanted God's Name in the hearts of Lord's devotees as an inexhaustible treasure.
6ZZ0: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.
O Brother! instruct this mind of yours.

O my soul! why are you indolent? Under Guru's instruction, ponder over Lord's Name. Pause.

The devotional service of God is to embrace love for God. If the pious person thinks deeply, (he shall understand this thing).
H3Q9: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.
By hypocrisy Lord's adoration is not performed. The words of dualism make the man miserable.

The Man, within whose heart is discrimination and reflection, by intermingling he intermingles not (with apostates.)
9J7K: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.
He, is said to be God's attendant who keeps God clasped to His heart.
P2TS: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.
Dedicating his soul and body he places them before the Lord, and roots out ego from within himself.

Blest and acceptable is the pious person who never suffers defeat.9
S2R1: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

Eighty-four lakhs (species of lives) long for the Lord. He whom (God) unites comes and blends (with Him).
YAGD: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||
Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained God and he ever remains absorbed in God's Name.
U8YM: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.
An ocean of peace is the Name of God. By Guru's grace it is procured.
1R1J: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.
By repeating Lord's Name, night and day, the mortal easily gets absorbed in the Name.

His mind is amalgamated with True God, and (his) tongue sings God's Praises.
3CF3: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.
O Brother! being engrossed in duality, the world is in misery.

The self-willed are impure, and are brimful with the pollution of sin of pride and desire.

Without God's Name pollution is not washed off and in birth and death the mortal becomes miserable.

They, who are engrossed in the short-lived play, are of avail neither in this world nor in the next one.
K0YQ: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.
The love of God's Name is the worship penance and self-mortification of the Guru-beloved.

The Guru-beloved ever meditates on the Name of the One, the Creator.

Nanak, contemplate over the Name of the Lord, who is the support of all the beings.

The perverse person is engrossed in worldly love and embraces not Lord's love and world-detachment.

He comprehends not Lord's Name, ever suffers pain and loses honour in God's Court.
UB76: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||
The pious shed their ego, are imbued with the Name and attain peace.
2YJ3: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.
O my mind! day and night, you ever remainest brimful with desires.
G20N: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||
By serving the True Guru, worldly attachment is completely burnt down and man remains detached in his home. Pause.

The Guru-ward does good deeds and blooms. God's affection brings bliss.

Day and night he ever performs Lord's service and stilling his self-conceit becomes care-free.
CUCY: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||
By great good fortune I have met the society of saint and attuned to God the seat of eternal bliss.
9F7E: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.
He is the saint and he the world renouncer, who abides God's Name in his heart.
PKT0: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.
Anger touches not his core at all, as he has shed his self-conceit from within himself.
ANVA: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||
The Name treasure the True Guru has shown to him and God's Nectar he drinks to his fill.
W30W: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.
Who-so-ever has found God, has found Him in the congregation of the righteous. Through the perfect good luck Lord's love is obtained.
YQKD: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.
Being inwardly attached with ego the perverse roam about and understand not the True Guru.
CKJS: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||
Nanak, they who are tinged with the word, get imbued in God's Name. How can they be dyed without the mordant of Lord's fear?
GDTQ: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.
Within man are all the Goods. From within his home he can obtain the required merchandise.
W5TZ: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.
Every moment remember God's Name. Hardly any one obtains it through the Guru.
5AB5: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||
The treasure of the Name is inexhaustible, through the greatest good luck it is attained to.
5KW2: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.
O my mind! abandon slander, self-conceit and arrogance.

9PYC: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||
Through the Guru do you ever remember the venerable Lord, the Unique Being. Pause.
VSR4: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Bright are the faces of the Guru-beloved. They reflect over Guru's words.
1E8L: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.
By pondering and deliberating over, in their mind, on God, the enemy of ego they obtain peace in this world and the next world.
XHE7: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
In their own house they get to Lord's presence by reflecting on Guru's words.
XQJN: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.
Black become the brows of those who turn their faces away from the True Guru.
9JNG: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.
By night and day, they do afflictive deeds, and death's noose ever spies them.
7YJP: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||
Even in dream they perceive not pleasure and are wholly burnt by intense anxiety.
NJN2: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.
One Lord's is the bestower of all. He Himself bestows bounties.
RFMZ: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.
He gives to him, whom He is pleased with. No one has any say in it.
GB8K: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||
Nanak, god is obtained through the Guru. He Himself understands His ownself.
36ND: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.
Serve the True Lord, who will grant you true greatness.
CQLB: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.
By Guru's grace, God abides within man's mind and drives away his pride.
HEMA: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||
When the Lord Himself casts His merciful glance, then alone is this fleeting mind restrained.
ECXA: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
O Brother! through the Guru meditate on Lord's Name.
4EDV: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
When the Name treasure ever abides in man's mind he finds a place in Lord's palace. Pause.
JHK8: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.
There is darkness within the mind and body of an apostate. He has neither shelter nor place of rest.
VEC2: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.
He continues roaming about, in many existences, like a crow in a deserted house.
33FW: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||
By Guru's teaching Divine Light shines in the heart and by his word God's Name is gained.
YV75: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.
You are blinded by the wickedness of three dispositions and the darkness of the attachment of wealth.
UD3Q: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.
The men of avarice serve others, even though they advertise their study of Vedas.
UYPT: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||
In sin they are burnt down to death. They are neither on this shore nor on the yonder.
0BRX: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.
In the love of wealth they have forgotten the Father of the World. the Cherisher.
XCJF: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.
Without the Guru, all the mortals are unmindful and are in the bondage of the myrmidon of death.
0RJF: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||
O Nanak! by pondering on the True Name, under Guru's instruction, you are saved.
R027: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.
In the three temperaments is the attachment of wealth. The Guru-beloved attains to the fourth state of celestial beatitude.
GZ2D: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.
The Lord mercifully unites with Himself those, within whose mind God's Name enters and acquires an abode.
6YHP: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||
They in whose treasure is benevolence, them the Lord unites with saints congregation.
XWFY: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.
O Brother! abide you in Truth by guru's instructions.
4SJ6: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Practise nothing but Truth and unite with the True Name. Pause.
7UC8: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
I am a sacrifice to those, who have recognised God's Name.
F2UB: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.
Having renounced my self conceit I fall at their feet and walk (act) in accordance with their-will.
J323: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||
Reaping the profit of Lord God's Name, I shall thus be easily absorbed in Name.
MVWW: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.
Without the Guru, man obtains not God's mansion, nor does he attain to His Name.
KTS9: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.
Search for and obtain such True Guru through whom mayest gain that True Lord.
NUHW: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||
He, who slays his evil passion abides in peace. What ever pleases Him that comes to pass.
BHD6: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.
As is the intensity of belief in the True Guru, so is the comfort, the mortal obtains.
C9EG: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.
There is absolutely no doubt in this, but only a rare person embraces love for the Guru.
5YWK: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||
Nanak, God and the Guru have two forms but they have the same one Light. It is by the word that mortal attains to the union with God.1
